script:
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$d=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'EasyCV-Downloads-20261102-Tools'
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $d){throw 'Tool download directory already exists'}
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $d | Out-Null
$p=Join-Path $d 'agent-browser-0.41.0.tgz'
& curl.exe --fail --silent --show-error --location --max-time 45 --output $p 'https://registry.npmjs.org/agent-browser/-/agent-browser-0.41.0.tgz'
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'Pinned npm package download failed'}
& tar.exe -xzf $p -C $d 'package/bin/agent-browser-win32-x64.exe'
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'Tool extraction failed'}
$exe=Join-Path $d 'package\bin\agent-browser-win32-x64.exe'
$hash=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $exe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
if($hash -ne 'dee86b78071cbe7217f71ec1c9df6a50efa73cd44d64a18877bb36556fc8e270'){throw 'Tool binary differs from inspected npm cache'}
@{source='https://registry.npmjs.org/agent-browser/-/agent-browser-0.41.0.tgz';toolSHA256=$hash;bytes=(Get-Item -LiteralPath $exe).Length;path=$exe;executed=$false} | ConvertTo-Json
